purpose: Issue #262 discovery-only original PDFs from TeXample.net. Each page links the unchanged PDF download and explicitly states CC BY-SA 4.0; preserve attribution to the listed author. No formal corpus admission is implied.

candidates.author: Paul Gaborit
candidates.license_evidence: The source page identifies the author and states Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International.
candidates.source_description: TikZ Olympic-rings example with even-odd fill paths; included as a comparison control, not assumed to contain W* clipping.

candidates.author: Dominique Wuertz
candidates.license_evidence: The source page identifies the author and states Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International.
